title: Bridging short- and medium-range weather forecasting with machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) employs independent prediction systems for distinct forecast products. While some separation is practical, we argue that combining short- and medium-range weather into a single prediction system would provide the public with a useful distillation of global weather and its impacts. To this end, we present Nested-EAGLE (Experimental Artificial intelligence Global and Limited-area Ensemble): a 0.25{\deg} global weather model with a 6 km refinement over the Contiguous United States (CONUS). The model achieves significantly lower mean-squared error in near-surface and low-level quantities over CONUS compared to NOAA's Global Forecast System and High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR), while remaining competitive throughout the rest of the global atmosphere. We show that the skill gains for near-surface fields stem from incorporating high-resolution regional analysis data into training

translated_title: 桥接短中期天气预报与机器学习
translated_abstract: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）为不同的预报产品采用独立的预测系统。虽然一定程度的分离是实用的，但我们认为将短期和中期天气预报合并为一个统一的预测系统，可以为公众提供全球天气及其影响的精炼信息。为此，我们提出了Nested-EAGLE（实验性人工智能全球与有限区域集合模型）：一个0.25度的全球天气模型，并在美国本土（CONUS）上提供6公里分辨率细化。该模型在美国本土的近地表和低层量上，与NOAA的全球预报系统和快速刷新高分辨率模型（HRRR）相比，实现了显著更低的均方误差，同时在其余全球大气中保持竞争力。我们表明，近地表场的技能提升源于在训练中纳入高分辨率区域分析数据。
tldr: 本文提出Nested-EAGLE模型，将短期和中期天气预报整合为一个系统，通过高分辨率区域数据训练，显著提升了美国本土的近地表预报精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Nested-EAGLE, which integrates short- and medium-range weather forecasting into a single system, significantly improving near-surface prediction accuracy over CONUS via high-resolution regional training data.
